-- DrLinq Core Database V1
-- PostgreSQL 15+
-- Designed for dentistry now and broader healthcare later.

CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;

CREATE TABLE organizations (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  organization_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (organization_type IN (
    'clinic','hospital','laboratory','radiology','pharmacy','office','other'
  )),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  city TEXT,
  province TEXT,
  address TEXT,
  phone TEXT,
  external_code TEXT,
  metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE practitioners (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  practitioner_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (practitioner_type IN (
    'dentist','physician','specialist','pharmacist','radiologist','lab_professional','other'
  )),
  first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  license_number TEXT,
  specialty_code TEXT,
  specialty_label TEXT,
  organization_id UUID REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  phone TEXT,
  email TEXT,
  metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE patients (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  patient_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  first_name TEXT,
  last_name TEXT,
  mobile TEXT,
  national_identifier_hash TEXT,
  birth_date DATE,
  sex TEXT,
  metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE cases (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  case_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  patient_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES patients(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  created_by_practitioner_id UUID REFERENCES practitioners(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  source_organization_id UUID REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  care_domain TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'dentistry',
  chief_complaint TEXT,
  summary TEXT,
  urgency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'routine' CHECK (urgency IN ('routine','urgent','emergency')),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (status IN ('open','referred','in_progress','completed','cancelled')),
  clinical_data JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE referrals (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  referral_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  case_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES cases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  from_practitioner_id UUID REFERENCES practitioners(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  from_organization_id UUID REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  to_practitioner_id UUID REFERENCES practitioners(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  to_organization_id UUID REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  requested_service_code TEXT,
  requested_service_label TEXT NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','accepted','declined','scheduled','completed','cancelled')),
  response_note TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  responded_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE TABLE clinical_documents (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  case_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES cases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  referral_id UUID REFERENCES referrals(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  document_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (document_type IN (
    'image','dicom','lab_result','report','prescription','pdf','other'
  )),
  title TEXT,
  storage_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  mime_type TEXT,
  sha256 TEXT,
  size_bytes BIGINT,
  dicom_study_uid TEXT,
  metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  uploaded_by_practitioner_id UUID REFERENCES practitioners(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  uploaded_by_organization_id UUID REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE consents (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  patient_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES patients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  case_id UUID REFERENCES cases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  consent_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  purpose TEXT NOT NULL,
  granted_to_organization_id UUID REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  granted_to_practitioner_id UUID REFERENCES practitioners(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active','revoked','expired')),
  granted_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  evidence JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
);

CREATE TABLE access_grants (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  case_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES cases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  practitioner_id UUID REFERENCES practitioners(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  organization_id UUID REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  permission TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (permission IN ('view','upload','comment','manage')),
  granted_by_practitioner_id UUID REFERENCES practitioners(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  valid_from TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  valid_until TIMESTAMPTZ,
  revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  CHECK (practitioner_id IS NOT NULL OR organization_id IS NOT NULL)
);

CREATE TABLE access_tokens (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  referral_id UUID REFERENCES referrals(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  purpose TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  used_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE audit_events (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  actor_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor_id UUID,
  action TEXT NOT NULL,
  resource_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  resource_id UUID,
  case_id UUID REFERENCES cases(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  ip_hash TEXT,
  user_agent_hash TEXT,
  details JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
);

CREATE INDEX idx_practitioners_org ON practitioners(organization_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_cases_patient ON cases(patient_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_cases_status ON cases(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_referrals_case ON referrals(case_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_referrals_target_org ON referrals(to_organization_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_referrals_status ON referrals(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_documents_case ON clinical_documents(case_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_consents_patient_case ON consents(patient_id, case_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_access_grants_case ON access_grants(case_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_audit_case_time ON audit_events(case_id, occurred_at DESC);

COMMENT ON TABLE clinical_documents IS 'Stores metadata only. Medical files must live in protected object storage/PACS, not in PostgreSQL or GitHub.';
COMMENT ON TABLE audit_events IS 'Append-only security audit trail. Application should never update or delete audit rows during normal operation.';
